cards.text: After his son Absalom's rebellion (2 Samuel 15:10), David's heading home, and the men of Israel and the men of Judah just argued over who has more claim to him (2 Samuel 19:41-43). Right then, a worthless man named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjamite, happens to be there. And friend, this man has TIMING, because he blows the ram's horn and starts shouting.

cards.question: Sheba shouts that Israel has no share in David, son of Jesse. So what's he calling the men of Israel to do?
Sheba's shout works. How many of the men of Israel desert David to follow him?
True or false: The men of Judah stay by King David all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

cards.text: Back at his palace in Jerusalem, David puts the ten concubines he left to take care of the palace in a house under guard. He provides for them, but he no longer sleeps with them.

cards.question: David's ten concubines are confined until the day they die, living as ___.

cards.text: David calls in Amasa, the man he named commander of his army in place of Joab (2 Samuel 19:13), and gives him a job with a deadline: summon the men of Judah, and be there himself.

cards.question: How much time does David give Amasa to summon the men of Judah?
True or false: Amasa gets back to David within the time David gave him.

cards.text: So David turns to Abishai, Joab's brother (2 Samuel 2:18), and tells him, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom."

cards.question: David tells Abishai to take his men and chase Sheba down. What is David afraid Sheba will find if they wait?

cards.text: Out of Jerusalem they march after Sheba: Joab's men, the Cherethites, the Pelethites and ALL the mighty men. That's a LOT of muscle for one guy with a horn.
At the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa joins them. Joab's dressed for battle with a dagger strapped to his belt, and as he steps forward, he slips the dagger from its sheath.

cards.question: True or false: With that dagger loose, Joab walks up and greets Amasa like a brother.

cards.text: "Are you well, my brother?" Joab asks, and with his right hand he grabs Amasa by the beard to kiss him. Amasa is not on guard against the dagger in Joab's hand, and Joab stabs him in the stomach, and Amasa is dead.

cards.question: Amasa lies dead on the road. What do Joab and his brother Abishai do next?

answers.text: Wait for the men of Judah

cards.text: One of Joab's young men stands near Amasa and calls out: whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, follow Joab.

cards.question: Amasa's body is lying in the middle of the road, and when the troops reach it, they ___.
True or false: Once the young man drags Amasa's body into a field and throws a garment over it, all the men go on with Joab after Sheba.

cards.text: Meanwhile, Sheba passes through all the tribes of Israel, and the Berites gather together and follow him. This man is collecting followers the way I collected DUST all those years in the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: Joab's troops finally catch up and trap Sheba inside a city. Which city?
Joab's troops build a siege ramp against the city's outer rampart. True or false: They also start battering the wall to topple it.

cards.text: The wall is taking a beating. Then a wise woman calls out from inside the city, "Listen! Listen!"

cards.question: From inside the city, a wise woman is shouting over the battering. What does she ask for?

cards.text: His army's been pounding the WALL, and Joab walks over and tells her he's listening. She's like Ruby, the bell, one of my cookie cutter kids: when she speaks up, people LISTEN.
She says, "Long ago they used to say, 'Seek counsel at Abel,' and that is how disputes were settled." In other words, this town was known for TALKING things out.

cards.question: The wise woman says she's among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, and Joab is trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. What does she ask Joab?

answers.text: Why he would swallow up the LORD's inheritance
Why he would bring a curse on his army
Why he would ignore the king's command

cards.text: Joab answers, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!" He tells her Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against King David.

cards.question: So Joab has no fight with the city itself. What does he want from it before he'll leave?
True or false: The wise woman promises Joab the city will hand Sheba over to him alive.

cards.text: She takes her wise counsel to all the people, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and throw it to Joab.

cards.question: Sheba kicked all this off by blowing a ram's horn. Now Joab blows one. What do Joab's men do?
When it's all over, Joab returns to King David in ___.

cards.text: The chapter wraps up with a list of David's officials, from the recorder to the scribe to the priests. And right at the top of that list is Joab, over the whole army of Israel.
